purpose: 使用MCP skill读取实际图谱结构
name: get-schema

purpose: 使用建模skill检查现有唯一约束
name: read-cypher

arguments.query: SHOW CONSTRAINTS YIELD name, type, labelsOrTypes, properties RETURN name,type,labelsOrTypes,properties

purpose: 使用导入skill检查索引状态
name: read-cypher

arguments.query: SHOW INDEXES YIELD name,state,populationPercent RETURN name,state,populationPercent
MATCH (n:Entity) RETURN n.datasetKind AS dataset,count(n) AS entities ORDER BY dataset

purpose: 断言、分类与总节点数量
name: read-cypher

arguments.query: MATCH (n:KGItem) RETURN count(n) AS allNodes, sum(CASE WHEN n:Assertion THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assertions, sum(CASE WHEN n:Classification THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS classifications

purpose: 实际空间通行演示及界面情境
name: read-cypher

arguments.query: MATCH (a:Assertion:Demo {predicate:'direct_access_to'})-[:SUBJECT]->(s:Entity:Demo) MATCH (a)-[:OBJECT]->(t:Entity:Demo) MATCH (a)-[:VIA]->(i:Interface:Demo) RETURN a.sourceId AS assertion,s.label AS source,t.label AS target,i.label AS interface,a.accessContextJson AS context ORDER BY assertion

purpose: 争议屋面断言的支持与冲突证据
name: read-cypher

arguments.query: MATCH (a:Assertion:Literature {sourceId:'F_1_roof_layered'})-[r:EVIDENCED_BY|CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE]->(e:Evidence:Literature)-[:FROM_SOURCE]->(s:Source:Literature) RETURN a.value AS value,a.status AS status,type(r) AS evidenceRole,e.sourceId AS evidence,s.title AS source ORDER BY evidenceRole

purpose: 分类判断不能混为正向类型事实
name: read-cypher

arguments.query: MATCH (c:Classification:Literature) RETURN c.sourceId AS classification,c.decision AS decision,c.criteriaResultsJson AS criteria ORDER BY classification

purpose: 导入完整性检查：标识缺失与重复
name: read-cypher

arguments.query: MATCH (n:KGItem) WITH n.uid AS uid,count(n) AS copies WHERE uid IS NULL OR copies>1 RETURN uid,copies

purpose: 不存在文献案例通行断言
name: read-cypher
